purpose: Teach: 美奈子/貞子/アヤ/マサ/わらしべ/ガンモ/キチン/逸品

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが姪の美奈子さんを可愛がられた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he was so fond of your niece Minako.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective opening. Soft voice, as if reaching back through decades. Slow pace. A light touch of wonder at the memory itself, not performing emotion.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、私の妹貞子と仲良くして下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and your father was so good to my younger sister Sadako, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, conversational. A gentle counter-offer — matching his memory with her own. Slight lift at "wasn't he" — not a question, but an invitation to agree. Affectionate ease.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「アヤさんは料理上手」と仰った
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to say Aya was such a good cook.
lines.style: Same quiet reach backward. A specific detail emerging — not performed, recalled. Slight breath before the quote. Listening to himself remember.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、マサ兄さんと将棋を指されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your father and older brother Masa used to play shogi together when he was young, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle echo-back, equally specific. "Shogi" lands with a small, concrete weight — a real detail. Warm tone. She's offering her own counter-memory, building together.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「わらしべ長者の教訓」を子供達に語られた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to tell the children the lesson of Warashibe Choja.
lines.style: Voice drops slightly, more reverent. This memory carries a different weight — moral, instructive. Slow delivery. Small pause before the story title, as if honoring what it meant.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ガンモ、つまりがんもどきを手作りされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your father used to make ganmo — those fried tofu pockets — from scratch when he was young, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warmth with a hint of pride. "Ganmo" spoken like a small treasure of a word. Conversational but grounded. She's adding the domestic detail — his hands, his care. Not rhetorical.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「キチン質の関節サプリ」を試された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he tried one of those joint supplement powders with chitin in them.
lines.style: Slightly lighter touch here — there's a whisper of gentle humor at the incongruity. Still wistful, but with a tiny smile in the voice. Not mocking — observant. Bemused recall.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、骨董市で逸品の茶碗を見つけられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your father found a beautiful antique tea bowl at the flea market when he was young, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, tender, with genuine delight in the discovery. "Tea bowl" lands softly — a treasure reclaimed. Affectionate at the close. This memory too is precious. She's savoring it with him.
